composition: house-photo hero with a separate enquiry surface
imagery: real roof and house photography in the reference

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct O'LYN Roofing homepage opens with a compact dark utility strip, a narrow brand and service navigation row, and a full-width house photograph with a bold uppercase message. A dark consultation form occupies a separate block beneath the desktop opening. A white service surface presents narrow roof-photo choices with short accent labels. Later chapters alternate an overlapping circular roof and worker image, a dark reassurance checklist, a recognition strip, a dark review-image band, a house image with an inset editorial panel, an image-backed before-and-after project comparison, another enquiry surface, and a place-context close. On mobile, the service choices form a vertical path and the contact route remains reachable while imagery and copy stack. The long list of places in the source footer is not a pattern for generated location pages. All source identity, copy, projects, photos, reviews, numbers, credentials, warranty and availability claims are reference-only.

acceptanceChecks: The opening names the new client's verified roofing scope, relevant coverage and working contact route without borrowing source claims.
Service choices, process, documented work and contact form a coherent decision path rather than a repeated card wall.
Any project comparison uses client-approved images with truthful labels; otherwise a practical process explanation fills that position.
At 390 px, service choices, comparison labels and contact controls remain readable, reachable and free of horizontal overflow.
No source identity, review, photograph, warranty, statistic, credential, address or doorway-style city list enters the generated page.

review.notes: Direct source returned HTTP 200 at desktop and mobile widths. Full-page PNGs inspected at 1440 and 390 px with no document-width overflow. Browser capture retained a small source cookie notice; no source-owner grant is claimed.
